verdict.rationale: Datalab documents completion webhooks for document processing jobs, configurable by default or per request via a `webhook_url` parameter. The docs also frame webhooks as an alternative to 'continuous polling', which implies an async job model with status polling, but that polling flow is never documented directly. missing for 10: explicit documentation of async job submission and a status-polling endpoint (request_id/check URL), webhook payload and retry details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, long parses run as async jobs with status polling and completion webhooks, so my pipeline never blocks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
You can override the default webhook URL for specific API requests by including the webhook_url parameter
Configure webhooks to receive real-time notifications when Datalab jobs complete.
